notes:
Prospect: large UK-headquartered payments platform expanding EU+Canada presence. Short bullets from calls and internal threads:
- 2026-02-18 intro call (Sofia) — high-level product fit: chat for merchant support + embeddings for fraud signal enrichment. Interested in Private VPC + regional controls.
- "Security first" repeated three times by CTO. Wants EU-only tenancy for EU customers; separate UK residency for UK-regulated merchants; Canada region for local card processors.
- Asked about audit log retention windows (required 7 years for some workflows) — legal flagged. Want configurable retention controls per-tenant.
- KMS: prefer BYOK for master keys, HSM-backed, must support AWS KMS + Azure Key Vault (some workloads in Azure).
- Latency: 95th percentile < 150ms for chat path; peak throughput 250 concurrent chat sessions; embeddings batch jobs 10k vectors/day. Cost sensitivity moderate — willing to commit reserved capacity if SLA and regional isolation guaranteed.
- POC proposed: 4-week Private VPC pilot in eu-west-1 with UK-only partitioning testcases + sample KMS integration. POC acceptance criteria: data residency proof, end-to-end audit logs, and successful failover to dedicated fallback model under load.
- Security review: initial questionnaire returned 2026-03-02; in-progress SOC2 docs requested; legal needs DPA addendum and model-usage clause.
- Quote from CTO on 2026-03-02: "We cannot have EU customer PII leave EU; need cryptographic controls and auditable key handles."
- Internal notes: prioritize solution that supports per-region isolation (resource tagging + VPC scoping) and explicit model routing policies for EU vs UK vs CA.
- Risk: if Redwood requires centralized control plane in US, legal may block; need clear control-plane residency or allowed data flows written in DPA.
sales_notes: Deal owner: Sofia. Two-tier approval needed (Tech + Legal). Likely to push to procurement if POC passes. They prefer fixed monthly for dedicated capacity after pilot.
technical_requirements_summary:
- Private VPC with isolated subnets per-region (EU, UK, CA).
- Control-plane residency constraints documented in DPA.
- BYOK KMS support (AWS + Azure) with HSM; key rotation policies exposed.
- Audit logs: token-level and request-level logs, configurable retention per tenant; export to customer SIEM.
- Model routing: enforce EU-only model variants; automatic fallback to smaller quantized variant on capacity constraints.
- Network: VPC peering or PrivateLink options; egress controls and allowed egress list.
recent_questions_from_prospect: Can Redwood guarantee no backups or caches stored outside specified region?
Is the control plane able to be hosted in EU/UK region?
Can we bring our own KMS and ensure key material never leaves HSM?
deal_risks: Primary risk is legal/regulatory rejection if control-plane or telemetry defaults route through US. Secondary risk: KMS integration complexity across multi-cloud. Pricing needs to be competitive vs internal self-host effort.
notes_short_summary: Enterprise fintech evaluating Redwood Private VPC for regionally isolated inference. Focus: EU-only + UK + Canada residency, BYOK KMS, audit log retention and per-tenant controls. POC scoped; legal and KMS are blockers.
